sentences.text:
Mahendra Kumar S/O Shri Rajendra Prasad vs State Of U.P.
Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

on 22 March, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 27
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6176 of 2022
Applicant :- Mahendra Kumar S/O Shri Rajendra Prasad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Sahu,Vijay Kumar

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant Mahendra Kumar, with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.383 of 2021, under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C.,and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Madhoganj, District Hardoi.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the charges have been framed but witnesses have not been examined before the court below.
He further submitted that FIR has been lodged against the applicant making allegation of rape due to enmity.
He submitted that real grand mother of victim is Pradhan and on her behest FIR was lodged due to enmity.
He submitted that there is no injury found in the medical report, therefore, it may be presumed that applicant has not committed any crime.
The applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is in jail since 23.08.2021.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that father has lodged the report mentioning that accused applicant over powered the prosecutrix and committed rape.
As per medical report, the age of the girl is 10 years.
As per statement recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. it is apparent that prosecutrix has narrated the fact that how the applicant had over powered her and committed rape.
She identified him before the court while making statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. as such the applicant does not deserve mercy and his bail is liable to be rejected.

entities.text: Rajendra Prasad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The fact that as per medical report, the age of the girl is 10 years, is minor and her statement goes to show that applicant over powered her and committed rape.
The statement of the girl recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. and the version of the FIR is intact and there is no reason to disbelieve the prosecution case at the moment.
Thus, having regard to the evidence available on record against the applicant and his complicity in the crime, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the bail application moved on behalf of applicant Mahendra Kumar is, hereby, rejected.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submitted that trial has yet not completed, evidences is not going on as such the trial court may be directed to take decision by concluding the trial.
However, the trial court is directed to proceed with the trial and make all efforts to conclude the same within one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Office is directed to send a copy of this order to the trial court concerned for necessary compliance forthwith.
